audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text calls Primordial Burst a 'true-damage execute'. It is neither: it is magic damage that scales with the target's missing health.

audit.corrected: Rewritten in spikes[1].text, whys[3] and dontsFull[2].d as missing-health scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit, and dosFull[2].d called Event Horizon a 'fifteen-second' cooldown.

audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns; dosFull[2].d corrected to twenty seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states the single fact that wins you the game: Veigar has no dash and no escape in his entire kit.
audit.why: Kit file: no dash flag on any Veigar ability. Riftwalk is 2s at rank 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim; dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim; wants.you[1] calls Baleful Strike a passive.
audit.why: lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED; the passive is Phenomenal Evil Power, Baleful Strike is the Q.

All seven side edits are proposed as one group with matching why rewrites. Both packet suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES: 'Primordial Burst' and 'Baleful Strike' are Veigar's real R and Q. The genuine naming error there was different — Primordial Burst was described as a TRUE-DAMAGE EXECUTE in spikes[1].text and as an 'execute' in whys[3], when Riot's text gives magic damage scaling with missing health. dosFull[2].d also advertised a 'fifteen-second' Event Horizon when it is 20s at rank 1 and only reaches 14s at rank 5; corrected. wants.you and wants.foe hold only three entries each here, but unlike the Twisted Fate matchup I had no fourth kit fact left that the page did not already state, so I did not invent one — recorded rather than filled.
